audience: construction firms that plan staffing and projects with Bridgit Bench

useCases.title: Find who can staff new work
useCases.text: Check how many days until each person is next available, with the availability windows. List the people in the account to see who can take on a new project.

useCases.title: Find unfilled roles on projects
useCases.text: List the salaried roles across projects and filter them to the unfilled ones. Read the projects with their state, dates and unfilled role counts.

useCases.title: See who is allocated to a project now
useCases.text: List the current projects of each person, filtered by project state or type. Open one person's allocations to see the roles they hold.

useCases.title: Check time off and unavailability
useCases.text: List the unavailability periods in the account, such as time off or pre-employment. Read one person's profile for the employment dates and the manager.

useCases.title: Review certifications and project phases
useCases.text: List the certifications held by people, with their issue and expiry details. List the ordered phases that a project moves through.
